caption: A surfer falls off their board, colliding briefly with another surfer, before swimming away.
first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: A surfer falls off their board, colliding briefly with another surfer, before swimming away. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: A surfer must lose balance and fall off their surfboard into the water.
The falling surfer must make contact with another surfer during the fall.
The impacted surfer must react to the collision, possibly shifting position or adjusting stance.
The fallen surfer must swim away from the scene after the collision.
